incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: High GPU queue growth in us-west-2 (p95 queue length > 1500) — autoscaler failing to allocate compatible MIG slices. Severity: SEV2. Pager: @alex_oncall. Logs: https://alerts.redwood.example/6801234567

alex_oncall: ack — jumping on it. grabbing metrics now.

sarah_ops: i'm seeing sustained enqueue rate ~3200 qps over last 10m, backlog spiking. autoscaler shows recent scale attempts: 3x failures due to 'no matching node with required MIG template'

mike_infra: confirming — there are free GPU slots but VLAN/instance labels mismatch. Looks like new mig-template v2 got applied to pool-A but many running nodes use v1 sizing, binpack can't place 8g jobs on 4g slices.

kendall_sre: can we evict low-priority batch jobs to free contiguous slots? which pools are affected?

sarah_ops: affected pools: pool-A (us-west-2a) and pool-B (us-west-2b). pool-A has ~1200 stranded GPU tokens (available gpu memory but wrong slice sizes), pool-B queue growing.

alex_oncall: runbook step 1: identify low-priority tags: `job.priority:low` — listing now.

deploy-bot: deployment 2026-03-15T10:01 triggered: patch mig-template -> v2 rolling. 7/40 nodes patched in pool-A.

eve_support: customer impact: three tenants report 503s on /v1/generate: tenant-chi, tenant-omega, tenant-beta. Support notified. CCs sent to account contacts, ETA message to customers: investigating.

mike_infra: quick mitigation option: enable temporary hetero-placement fallback so scheduler can place v1 jobs on v2 nodes by allowing smaller MIG carveouts. downside: possible perf regression. Thoughts?

kendall_sre: if fallback isn't safe, alternative is forced repack: drain/replace nodes to align MIG templates then trigger emergency repack. That will cause short evictions but will restore binpacking.

sarah_ops: metrics dump:
```
queue_length: 1700 -> 2450 (10m)
scale_attempts: 5 failed (no-match)
stranded_capacity: 1186 gpu-units
affected_requests_p95_latency: 4.2s -> 12.6s
errors /v1/generate: 1200 (10m)
```

alex_oncall: executing controlled evict of low-priority jobs on pool-A now: `./scripts/evict-low-priority --pool pool-A --limit 200`. Notifying batch owners.

mike_infra: I'm starting manual node label sync on 3 nodes to see if quick placements succeed: `kubectl label node gpu-node-12 mig-template=v2 --overwrite`

eve_support: ETA update to customers: "we're actively mitigating GPU placement issues, expect service restoration within 30-45 minutes. We'll follow up with post-incident notes."

kendall_sre: note: if we repack, autoscaler might oscillate. plan: after repack, set autoscale cooldown 10m and limit parallel repacks to 2 to avoid cascading evictions.

sarah_ops: evict script completed: 180 low-priority jobs terminated, freed ~540 gpu-units. queue length dipped to 1600. scale attempts still failing due to template mismatch on 4 nodes.

alex_oncall: manual label tweaks allowed 6 placements, brought throughput up ~12%. queue now 1200. still above normal.

mike_infra: requesting approval to trigger emergency repack for pool-A (drain 8 nodes, relaunch with consistent mig-template v2). Expected customer impact: short-term 2-3 minute inference interruptions for some in-flight requests on those nodes.

eve_support: approve, but we must update customers immediately before repack. I'll run the bulletin.

kendall_sre: @alex_oncall start repack playbook step `repack-emergency --pool pool-A --concurrency 2` and keep autoscale paused for pool-A during operation.

alex_oncall: repack initiated at 6801234700. pausing autoscaler for pool-A.

sarah_ops: repack logs:
```
node gpu-node-21 drained
node gpu-node-21 recreated with mig-template=v2
placement engine rebalanced running jobs
repack: 2/8 nodes complete
```

mike_infra: after 6/8 nodes, placements stabilized. queue dropped to 420. errors down to 80 in last 10m.

eve_support: customer bulletin: "Placed repack underway; telemetry shows steady improvement for affected tenants. If you still see 503s, please open a ticket and include request id." Sent to tenant-chi, tenant-omega, tenant-beta.

kendall_sre: repack finished at 6801234780. autoscaler re-enabled. monitoring for oscillation.

alex_oncall: post-mortem notes to collect: cause = mixed mig-template rollout + autoscaler didn't detect template incompatibility. mitigation = emergency repack + targeted evictions + manual label fixes. action items: 1) block mig-template rollouts until autoscaler compatibility check exists, 2) add alert for stranded_capacity > X, 3) improve runbook to recommend autoscale cooldown on repack.

incident-bot: Incident status: Mitigated (progressing) — queue decreasing, customer impact reduced. Follow-up meeting scheduled at 2026-03-15T11:00. :white_check_mark:
